name: Condado de Huelva

known.via: English Wikipedia "Condado de Huelva (DO)" (redirects to "Condado de Huelva")

terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: An Andalusia appellation in the south-east of Huelva province. Its wines are known as the Wines of the Discovery of America. Rules allow still and liqueur wines from Zalema, Palomino Fino, Pedro Ximénez and Moscatel.
